Write a simple calculator that takes two numbers and an operator.

Supplied answer
a = float(input("Enter first number: "))
b = float(input("Enter second number: "))
op = input("Enter operator (+ - * /): ")
if op == "+":
    print(a + b)
elif op == "-":
    print(a - b)
elif op == "*":
    print(a * b)
elif op == "/":
    print("Cannot divide by zero" if b == 0 else a / b)
else:
    print("Invalid operator")
Note: Always handle division by zero - interviewers look for this check.
